Natural Language:
When the green light is on, vehicles are allowed to
pass, but turning vehicles shall not hinder the passing of
straight vehicles and pedestrians that are being released.

When the yellow light is on, vehicles that have crossed
the stop line can continue to pass

When the red light is on, vehicles are prohibited from
passing. When the red light is on, vehicles turning right
can pass without hindering the passage of vehicles or
pedestrians.
Ground Truth: G(((trafficLightColor_red & stoplineAhead & !directionRight) -> F !drive) & ((trafficLightColor_red & stoplineAhead & directionRight & !PriorityNPCAhead & !PriorityPedsAhead) -> F drive))

Natural Language:
When the green arrow light is on, allow vehicles in the
lane to pass in the direction indicated;

When the red cross-shaped light or arrow light is on,
vehicles in the lane are prohibited from passing

The flashing warning
signal light is a yellow light that continues to flash, remind-
ing vehicles and pedestrians to pay attention when passing
through, and pass after confirming safety.
